title: 马克·吐温的假期
paragraphs: Mark Twain was a famous American writer. He loved writing, hunting and fishing very much. Once he went to Maine on vacation and spent three happy weeks there.

When he decided to get back, Mark Twain went to the station with his baggage (行李). After putting it on the train, he sat in a comfortable seat. A few minutes later, a man came over and sat next to him. Mark Twain looked at the man and found that he was unhappy. He thought it would be impolite to say nothing at that moment, so he said good morning to the man first and began to chat with him. They talked about the weather and then Maine. The man said, “We have some beautiful woods in Maine, and I guess you have been there, haven’t you?”

“Yes, I have,” answered Mark Twain, “I have just spent three pleasant weeks there, and I’d like to tell you something: Though fishing isn’t allowed in Maine this season, I’ve got two hundred pounds of beautiful fish. I like eating fish, so I put them on ice to take them home. May I know something about you, sir?”
The man looked at Mark Twain for several seconds and answered, “I’m a policeman. My job is to catch people who hunt and fish during the wrong season. And what do you do?”
Mark Twain answered, “Well, sir, I’m the man who tells the biggest lie in America.”

questions.stem: How long did Mark Twain stay in Maine?
questions.reason: 选C：Three weeks。首段说Mark Twain在Maine度过three happy weeks，后面对话又重复three pleasant weeks，两处都对应三周。不要把weeks误读为months，也不要把后文捕鱼的two hundred当作停留时长。

questions.stem: How did Mark Twain go home?
questions.reason: 选B：By train。第二段依次写到车站、把行李放上火车、坐到舒适座位，证据共同指向坐火车回家。题目问回程交通方式，不是他在度假地如何出游；其余交通方式均未被描述。

questions.stem: The man in the passage was ____.
questions.reason: 选B：a policeman。男子在对话中直接说明“I'm a policeman”，职责是抓捕禁猎禁渔季节违规的人。writer是Mark Twain的身份，fisherman/hunter是与故事活动有关的干扰项，不能因谈到捕鱼就给男子套上该职业。

questions.stem: Mark Twain’s vacation in Maine is ____.
questions.reason: 选A：enjoyable。首段three happy weeks和后文three pleasant weeks都说明假期愉快，enjoyable与happy/pleasant意义对应。返程遇警察时的尴尬不等于整个假期不愉快；unpleasant、terrible与两处明确评价相反。

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT true about Maine?
options: It’s a good place for vacation.
There is a railway station there.
Fishing is allowed in Maine all year round.
questions.reason: 选D：Fishing is allowed … all year round。题目选NOT true，原文却说某个季节fishing isn't allowed，故“全年都允许”夸大了范围。愉快度假、美丽树林及车站均在文中出现，是有依据的正确信息。
